PBM_EMAIL.submission: Express Scripts Pharmacist Resource Center portal (prc.express-scripts.com), Appeals tab; MACDepartment@express-scripts.com is the listed appeal contact; the Cigna MAC form (Express Scripts affiliate network) also accepts fax or email
attachments: wholesaler invoice showing the NDC of the disputed claim and latest acquisition cost, redacted to required items
PBM_EMAIL.appeal_window: 30 days from claim fill date or the period required by state law (Cigna MAC Pricing Review Form; Express Scripts' own window not found)
PBM_EMAIL.required_fields_basis: Cigna form fields: NCPDP ID, BIN, PCN, Rx number, NDC, claim fill date, drug name/strength/form, compound indicator, reason; invoice with NDC mandatory. The Express Scripts portal form itself was not found. Our vocabulary maps to ndc, rx_number, fill_date plus invoice-derived invoice_date and acquisition_cost.
PBM_EMAIL.contact: MACDepartment@express-scripts.com, 314-684-5606, https://prc.express-scripts.com (MS Dept of Insurance sheet, May 2021)

PBM_FAX.channel_note: The current OptumRx guide accepts portal spreadsheet submission only; email is for supporting invoices in AR and TN. Fax is not a current OptumRx door (a 2015-2016 Catamaran form used fax). The fax channel here is a demo choice to show channel breadth.
PBM_FAX.submission: OptumRx Pharmacy Portal with OptumID, approved MAC Appeal spreadsheet; any other form of submission is not accepted
attachments: invoice only on request or state-specific (AR and TN invoices emailed to MAC@Optum.com with Rx number, fill date, NDC in body)
PBM_FAX.appeal_window: 30 days from claim fill date or the period required by state law; TN 7 business days; late appeals not reviewed
PBM_FAX.response_sla: TN 7 business days after complete submission; no general SLA published
PBM_FAX.required_fields_basis: Guide requires BIN, NCPDP ID, Rx number (12 digits), fill date, reason for review; per-unit acquisition cost required in AR, MS, NM, TN, WA and others; TN notes column takes the wholesaler or manufacturer name. NDC is required in the emailed invoice context (AR). invoice_number is not requested, so it is not in this spec.
